document.purpose: Cheat sheet ngắn gọn cho project hiện tại.

must_know.mode: multi-tenant SaaS with shared Knowledge Bases
must_know.chat: stateless for users, fire-and-forget async audit persistence for admins (90d retention)
must_know.caching: Tiered L0 FAQ O(1) ~20ms -> L1 Exact (Redis ~0.5ms) -> L2 Semantic (0.95 threshold) with refusal empty payload guard
must_know.escalations: Auto-creates open escalation row on AI refusal ('Chưa đủ căn cứ') for admin review into FAQ
must_know.quota: Dynamic rates & quotas read from DB tenants table (RPM, monthly requests/tokens) & SQLite platform_settings
must_know.time: DB lưu UTC, backend/frontend format giờ Việt Nam khi hiển thị
must_know.delete_order: registry -> vectors -> sections -> file -> DB row -> purge

important_notes: User chat flow 100% stateless; Admin audit persistence handles turn-by-turn logging asynchronously via Celery
Tenant isolation là bắt buộc ở document, KB, retrieval, quota, usage
Admin Audit UI tại /admin/conversations cho phép xem câu hỏi 'Chưa đủ căn cứ' để nâng cấp tài liệu KB
Tiến trình ingestion/chat sử dụng SSE (Server-Sent Events) với tự động kết nối lại
